dt-example.title: Column order
dt-example.info:
The [ColReorder extension](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/colreorder) for DataTables provides the end user with the ability to reorder columns to suit their needs. This example demonstrates StateRestore's ability to save and restore the order of columns as set by ColReorder.
The `columnOrder` option of `-init stateRestore.include` option is set to `null` in this example, so you can selectively include, or exclude, the column order in the state.
